name: factory-live
description: The software factory inside Claude Code: a status line, a band when a job needs you, notifications, and a /factory-board pane where you watch agents (robot avatars in their own colours) and message them mid-run. Needs the factory plugin.

notify.title: Notify when a job needs you
notify.description: Raise a native notification when a factory job escalates, waits for plan approval or is blocked.

statusLine.title: Factory status line
statusLine.description: Show what the factory is doing under the prompt.

factoryctl.title: factoryctl path
factoryctl.description: Absolute path to factoryctl, when it is not installed beside this plugin.
